scope: Full electronic-codebook (ECB) concept article only; no completion claim for block-cipher-mode, AES, DES, other modes or the whole library.

coverageRationale.zh: 专门解释 ecb 这一实体：独立块加密、无 IV、并行性、完整块与填充，以及确定性导致的模式泄露；不把 AES、DES、工作模式层或其他模式并入本实体。
coverageRationale.en: Covers the ecb entity: independent block encryption, no IV, parallelism, full blocks and padding, and determinism-driven pattern leakage. It does not absorb AES, DES, the mode layer or other modes.
